div.span: 1 Version drift: each PC runs whatever was last installed on it
2 One cable fault or broadcast storm stops the whole floor
3 One database server: a disk or CPU fault stops everyone
4 Tapes exist, but nobody has rehearsed a restore
5 Leased line down: head office gets no overnight file

text.tspan: 1 Version drift: each PC runs whatever was last installed on it
2 One cable fault or broadcast storm stops the whole floor
3 One database server: a disk or CPU fault stops everyone
4 Tapes exist, but nobody has rehearsed a restore
5 Leased line down: head office gets no overnight file
